value.value: The Zn-only solution shows four strong short-range peaks below 3 angstrom; nitrate N-O is assigned at 1.2 angstrom and Zn-O near 2.0 angstrom. The source compares tetrahedral and octahedral reference distances and favors octahedral Zn-aquo monomers. The background reference to octahedral Zn in ZnAl2O4 is not silently substituted for the normal-spinel description.
